blocks.text: Flipkart is choosing its next home in Andheri East. Three buildings made the shortlist. Each one solves a different problem.
Two of them sit at Marol Naka, where Metro Line One meets Line Three. The third is a short ride west, in Chakala.
Privilon is right beside Marol Naka metro. A hundred and forty metres from the station steps. Two minutes on foot.
A new Grade A tower, ground plus fifteen, with one long, clear floor plate.
On one floor, the plan works at two hundred and sixty, two hundred and eighty, or three hundred and one seats, so the floor can grow with the team.
Corporate Avenue, in Chakala, is a gated office campus. It is already furnished, and ready to move into today.
Two floors, the third and the fourth. Twelve thousand four hundred square feet of carpet each. Two plans per floor let separate teams keep their own space, one stair apart.
Western Express Highway metro is twelve minutes on foot.
723 Avenue gives Flipkart the top of a new building: the thirteenth and fourteenth floors, with the open terrace above.
Inside, a bare-shell floor ready to fit out Flipkart's way. And the terrace comes with it: Flipkart's own place to step out between focused hours.
Marol Naka metro is about ten minutes away.
Three buildings. Three ways for Flipkart's teams to work together.
Walk through each one, compare the plans, and tell us what matters. We'll take it from there.
